# Atlas's own filled symbols, for kinds of place no open set draws. The owner, 10 November, "Yes, ok": every kind of
# place and every category wears a filled symbol, Temaki's first, then Maki's, then Pinhead's, and where no set draws
# the thing, Atlas draws it filled on Temaki's 15 grid. The outline drawings stay where the interface draws them.
#
# One drawing a line: name <TAB> SVG <path> elements on Temaki's 15 grid (viewBox 0 0 15 15), filled shapes only,
# no strokes (fill-rule="evenodd" where a shape is cut out of another). A comment line above each says what it shows.
# build_places_data.py (--mends, and the full build) puts each into symbols.json as atlas-<name>, beside the open
# sets'. They are Atlas's own: nothing that counts or credits the open sets by their prefixes (maki-, temaki-,
# pinhead-) takes them, and the boards are not changed by them.
# Each is held to the kinds' measures (EmblemShapeTest): centred, inside its frame, no pinholes, no parts that
# nearly touch, no hairlines; and to their look (KindsTest): no other kind or category on its shape.
